title: Free Car? Grandma Says OTP First! 🚗 | Hullabaloo Cartoon Colony | English Cartoon Comedy
description:
Grandma just got the shock of her life—she has supposedly won a brand new luxury car! The entire colony is buzzing with excitement, hanging garlands and readying a grand welcome for a vehicle that exists only in a scammer's imagination. As the neighborhood gets busy planning the victory parade, the caller is busy fishing for that one tiny OTP. Will the colony realize they are being played before the party starts? Watch the chaos unfold in this hilarious episode! Subscribe for more weekly colony madness.
